notes.before: controller defaults before the fix (max_body_lead 0.10, max_body_lead_lateral 0.03, max_yaw_lead 0.20)
notes.after: new defaults: trot max_body_lead 0.06 m, max_body_lead_lateral 0.015 m, max_yaw_lead 0.05 rad; crawl keeps 0.10 / 0.03 / 0.20 (crawl_max_*)
notes.lat20: joint commands 20 ms (2 control periods) late, MPC result 30 ms late (fixed)
notes.mpc50: MPC result 50 ms late (slow / loaded machine), command latency 10 ms
notes.mpc100: MPC result 100 ms late, command latency 10 ms
notes.criteria: fall = |roll| or |pitch| > 55 deg or base z < 0.12 m for >= 0.1 s, or controller FALLEN; see tools/gazebo_check/scenarios.py
notes.npz: per-run logs referenced by 'npz' live in the work directory of the run (not committed)
notes.mujoco_same_load: tools/physics_check.py, seeds 0-2, same CPU load: old leash b_trot 3/3, f_push 2/3, g_payload 3/3; trot 0.03 m: 2/3, 0/3, 2/3; adopted 0.06 m: 3/3, 1/3, 3/3
notes.before_after_history: before / after / *_lat20 / *_mpc50 / after_mpc100: MPC body-target leash fix (previous stage, MPC was the only mode); constant commands then started at 4.0 s for every seed
notes.stable_vs_mpc: locomotion_mode comparison (module1 README section 4.6): stable* = CHAMP-style kinematic gait (default), mpc* = 5 s MPC; constant commands start 0.07 s later per seed, pushes 0.13 s later per seed
notes.suffixes: (none) latency 10 ms; _lat0 0 ms; _lat2 20 ms; _rtf05 real-time factor 0.5 (MPC delay = 0.5 x wall solve time); _drop30 30 % control ticks dropped; _map ground-truth elevation map (stand-in for depth camera -> terrain_mapper); _blind no map; mpc_mpc100 MPC result 100 ms late
notes.mpc_jobs: mpc* runs used 6 parallel workers (measured MPC solve time = result delay), stable* 14 (no MPC)
notes.scenarios_new: f_pipe 0.08 m pipe, g_ramp / h_ramp_down 11.8 deg ramp (plant corridor), i_push 3 x 10 N s pushes

plant_note: plant_* / proposal_* blocks: the real simulation/worlds/plant.sdf (tools/gazebo_check --terrain plant via the j..o scenarios), map: depth = emulated depth camera + terrain_mapper pipeline, truth = ground-truth height grid, '' = blind. proposal_* add the controller fix in config.controller_patch and the parameters in config.params.
